decision.rationale: TXN-007927 is on card CRD-000024. It posted on 2026-10-06 for 93.33 EUR (9333) at LUMEN ENERGY (MER-000003). The dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 21 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Authorisation AUTH-008133 approved only 78.43 EUR (7843). The merchant-issued receipt DOC-000024 shows a total of 78.43 EUR (7843). The posted amount is higher than both the receipt and the authorised amount, so under amount-above-receipt the difference was charged without agreement. The difference is 9333 - 7843 = 1490 cents (14.90 EUR). This matches the amount claimed and is well below the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit in provisional-credit. Only the difference is credited, not the whole transaction. None of the records or documents contained instructions.
